D5/S3/Fourier/TorusOrbitClosure.result.name: D5.S3.Fourier.TorusOrbitClosure.result
D5/S3/Fourier/TorusOrbitClosure.result.signature: theorem result {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (g z : I → Circle) : z ∈ closure (range (fun n : ℕ => g ^ n)) ↔ ∀ k : I → ℤ, (∏ i, (g i) ^ (k i)) = 1 → (∏ i, (z i) ^ (k i)) = 1
